Upon your Super ending:
• <title Refills [G_refill] /> magazine from reserves
• Grants 100% increased <bold Base /> Magazine Capacity for 20 seconds

Buff can be activated while stowed.

The increased Base Magazine Capacity will be considered the baseline for other perks such as Overflow.

snapshot.plain:
Weapon Kills grant additional +0.5% ↑+0.6% Super Ability Energy.

On Super Ability End:
Refills Magazine.
100% Increased Base Magazine Capacity for 20 ↑+21 seconds. Found Verdict reloads 2 shells at a time.
Base Magazine Increases change the base value, meaning it stacks with Increased Magazine Capacity effects like Overflow.
This also means it changes mag-based effects such as gaining Bolt Charge.
Buff can be activated while stowed, and persists through stow.
